plots.brief: The merchants' bank on the corner where the market-east street meets West Avenue, about 16x16 with roof overhang room, three storeys. Calcite and diorite on a chiselled stone-brick plinth with smooth-stone quoins, deepslate-tile roof and a small oxidised-copper cupola on the corner. Ground-floor banking hall behind an arcade of three tall arches facing the market (door west), strongroom with iron bars above, blue banners either side of the door. Detail: a copper-gilded scale sign hanging over the door.

Tall three-storey merchant house, about 9x9 walls on a 14x14 plot, fronting West Avenue (door north). Ground-floor counting room with big mullioned windows, storeys above are warehouse lofts with a hoist beam and loading hatch under the gable. Calcite and diorite, smooth-stone trim, dark oak shutters, deepslate roof. Twin to merchants_house_n2 across the garden; detail: copper gutters and a hanging shop sign.

A small public garden on the south bank of the little pond just north (around x -2482), about 17x14, entered from West Avenue. Stone-brick paths, low calcite walls, hedges of azalea leaves, flowering beds, two benches of spruce stairs and a small copper-roofed pavilion by the water. Detail: a tiny stone footbridge or stepping stones at the pond edge.

Small two-storey money-changers' shop, about 8x6 walls on a 13x10 plot, on Copper Lane near the market-east street (door south). Pale stone with a barred counter window facing the lane, dark oak shutters, deepslate roof. Detail: a scales-and-coins sign in copper and a small strongbox alcove visible through the window.

Tall three-storey merchant house, about 9x9 walls on a 14x14 plot, fronting the market-east street (door west). Ground-floor shop with open arcade bay, counting room behind, warehouse lofts above with a hoist. Calcite and diorite on a stone plinth, smooth-stone trim, dark oak shutters, deepslate roof. Pair with merchants_house_w2; give this one a stepped gable. Detail: blue banner on a bracket.

Three-storey merchant house, about 9x8 walls on a 14x13 plot, second of the pair on the market-east street (door west). Counting room below, warehouse lofts above, calcite and diorite with smooth-stone trim and dark oak shutters, deepslate roof with a different gable than its twin to the north. Detail: a copper gutter and downspout and a crane arm over the loft door.

Wealthy three-storey merchant house, about 10x9 walls on a 15x14 plot, facing the east ring street (door east), with a small forecourt. Shop and counting room on the ground floor, warehouse lofts above, calcite with diorite banding, smooth-stone trim, dark oak shutters, deepslate roof. Detail: a copper-roofed oriel window on the first floor.

Three-storey merchant house, about 10x8 walls on a 15x13 plot, twin of merchants_house_e1 on the east ring street (door east). Counting room below, lofts above with a hoist beam, calcite and diorite, smooth-stone trim, dark oak shutters, deepslate roof. Detail: a blue banner and a lantern-lit door with a stone step.

Tall three-storey merchant house, about 10x9 walls on a 15x14 plot, on Copper Lane (door south). Open arcaded shop bay on the ground floor, counting room behind, warehouse lofts above. Calcite and diorite on a chiselled plinth, smooth-stone trim, dark oak shutters, deepslate roof. Detail: copper downspouts and a goods-crane over a loft door.
